heroHeadline: Day 185: Los Mezcales' CJNG-Linked Second-in-Command Captured in Oaxaca as Multi-State Raids Net 32 Detainees
heroSubtitle: Day 185 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). LOS MEZCALES SECOND-IN-COMMAND CAPTURED (Aug 21): C.M.M.M., alias 'El Abulón,' second-in-command of 'Los Mezcales' — a CJNG-linked armed wing blamed for violence across Colima state — was captured in a joint SEMAR/Oaxaca state prosecutor's office operation in Ejido Guadalupe Victoria, Oaxaca. MULTI-STATE RAID + EXOTIC ANIMALS SEIZED (Aug 24): Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch announced 20 alleged CJNG members detained in Aug 21-23 raids across 36 properties in Hidalgo, Jalisco, and Michoacán — 113 vehicles, a drone/jammer, firearms, drugs, and tigers and panthers held in poor captivity conditions were seized; combined with the Aug 19 Tío Lako-cell raid, 32 total CJNG members detained in under a week. SIX-MONTH RETROSPECTIVE (Aug 22): Marking half a year since El Mencho's death, Infobae detailed CJNG's reorganization under confirmed leader El 03 (Juan Carlos Valencia González), naming 'El Chorro' (Julio Alberto Castillo Rodríguez) as El Mencho's son-in-law and a lieutenant alongside El Sapo; cartel estimated at 15,000-20,000 members across 8 states. TÍO LAKO STILL AT LARGE (Aug 22): La Jornada reports the hunt continuing across Michoacán and Jalisco; detainee count from the Aug 19 raid rose to 12. TÍO LAKO CELL RAID + BLOCKADES (Aug 19): Federal forces raided cells tied to regional CJNG commander Heraclio Guerrero Martínez ('Tío Lako') in Tanhuato and Ecuandureo, Michoacán, initially detaining 9 people — including his daughter and romantic partner — and seizing heavy weapons, grenade launchers, IEDs, and a drone. CJNG retaliated within hours with roadblocks and vehicle burnings across roughly a dozen Michoacán municipalities; a later-reported confrontation left a preliminary, SEDENA-unconfirmed count of 5 civilians dead. FRANCISCO ÁLVAREZ SOLORIO BREAKS SILENCE (Aug 21): Son of jailed 'Los Rs' cell leader 'El R-1,' accused of instigating the Valeria Márquez femicide, gave his first interview from hiding, denying involvement. DEA 'GLOBAL HUNT' DECLARED (Aug 13): DEA Administrator Terry Cole announced an international campaign against CJNG from Tampa, FL, invoking its foreign-terrorist-organization designation. DOJ/STATE $102M REWARD PACKAGE (Aug 5): El 03's bounty raised to $25M, plus $15M each for El Jardinero, El Sapo, and El Chorro. SUCCESSION BINARY HOLDS: El 03 (confirmed leader, $25M) vs. El Sapo (military wing/Puerto Vallarta plaza boss, $15M) — both remain at large. DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13), El R-1/Los Rs (arrested Jul 30). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 49+ CJNG HVTs neutralized; 32 additional lower-level CJNG members detained in the past week.
